items.def_en: A sudden, abnormal drop in yield beyond the expected baseline.
items.example: We detected a yield excursion on lot A123 during wafer sort in WW32.
items.example_zh: 我們在 WW32 的 wafer sort 發現批號 A123 出現良率異常。

items.def_en: The electrical test performed on each die while it is still on the wafer.
items.example: All affected lots were re-tested at wafer sort before we released them.
items.example_zh: 所有受影響的批次在放行前都重新做了一次 wafer sort。

items.def_en: The characteristic pattern of a failure that points to its likely cause.
items.example: The failure signature is a ring pattern at the wafer edge, not random defects.
items.example_zh: 失效特徵是晶圓邊緣的環狀分佈，不是隨機缺陷。

items.def_en: The underlying reason a problem occurred, not just the visible symptom.
items.example: The root cause was a drifting chamber pressure on furnace tool F02.
items.example_zh: 根本原因是 F02 爐管的腔體壓力漂移。

items.def_en: Immediate action taken to stop bad material from reaching the customer.
items.example: As containment, we put all sister lots on hold and added a screening test.
items.example_zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們扣住所有同期批並加了一道篩選測試。

items.def_en: A permanent fix that removes the root cause so the issue will not recur.
items.example: The corrective action is a tighter pressure spec with automatic tool shutdown.
items.example_zh: 矯正措施是收緊壓力規格，並加上機台自動停機。

items.def_en: A status that blocks a lot from moving to the next process step.
items.example: We placed a lot hold on twelve wafers pending the FA result.
items.example_zh: 我們對十二片晶圓下了批次扣留，等 FA 結果出來再說。

items.def_en: A category that a tested die is sorted into according to its test result.
items.example: The bin 7 failure rate jumped from 0.4% to 3.1% in one week.
items.example_zh: bin 7 的失效率一週內從 0.4% 跳到 3.1%。

items.def_en: The number of defects per unit area on a wafer.
items.example: Defect density at the metal layer doubled after the tool maintenance.
items.example_zh: 機台保養後，金屬層的缺陷密度變成兩倍。

items.def_en: The range of process settings within which the product still meets spec.
items.example: The new recipe gives us a wider process window at the same throughput.
items.example_zh: 新配方在相同產出下給了我們更寬的製程窗口。

items.def_en: The normal, expected performance level used as a reference for comparison.
items.example: Yield returned to baseline two weeks after the corrective action.
items.example_zh: 矯正措施導入兩週後，良率回到基準水準。

items.def_en: The threshold that triggers an alarm and an investigation when crossed.
items.example: Lot A123 crossed the excursion limit, so the system alerted us automatically.
items.example_zh: 批號 A123 超過異常界限，系統自動發出警報。

items.def_en: Cell data corruption caused by repeated reads of neighbouring word lines.
items.example: We reproduced the read disturb failures after one million read cycles.
items.example_zh: 我們在一百萬次讀取後重現了讀取干擾的失效。

items.def_en: Unintended threshold voltage shift in cells next to the one being programmed.
items.example: Program disturb was ruled out because the fail bits sit on unrelated pages.
items.example_zh: 寫入干擾已被排除，因為失效位元落在不相關的 page 上。

items.def_en: How many program and erase cycles a block can take before it fails.
items.example: The device still meets the 3,000-cycle endurance spec after the change.
items.example_zh: 變更後元件仍符合 3,000 次的耐久度規格。

items.def_en: The ability of a cell to keep its data over time without power.
items.example: Retention was verified with a 168-hour bake at 125 degrees Celsius.
items.example_zh: 資料保存力已用 125°C、168 小時的高溫烘烤驗證。

items.def_en: The fraction of bits read incorrectly, usually written as RBER.
items.example: The raw bit error rate stayed below the ECC budget in all corner conditions.
items.example_zh: 在所有極端條件下，原始位元錯誤率都低於 ECC 的容許量。

items.def_en: The formal test program that proves a product or change is ready for production.
items.example: The qualification report will be ready before the customer audit in WW38.
items.example_zh: 認證報告會在 WW38 客戶稽核前完成。

items.def_en: Accelerated testing under harsh conditions to expose long-term weaknesses.
items.example: No new failures appeared after 500 hours of reliability stress.
items.example_zh: 在 500 小時的可靠度應力測試後沒有出現新的失效。

items.def_en: A high-temperature test that screens out parts likely to fail early.
items.example: We added a temporary burn-in step until the root cause is confirmed.
items.example_zh: 在根本原因確認前，我們暫時加了一道高溫老化測試。

items.def_en: One individual chip cut from a wafer.
items.example: Only three die per wafer failed, and all of them sit at the same location.
items.example_zh: 每片晶圓只有三顆晶粒失效，而且位置都相同。

items.def_en: A picture showing where passing and failing die sit on the wafer.
items.example: The wafer map shows a clear edge ring, which points to the anneal step.
items.example_zh: 晶圓分佈圖顯示明顯的邊緣環，指向退火製程。

items.def_en: A sliced view of a device used to inspect its internal structure.
items.example: The cross-section confirmed a void in the tungsten plug.
items.example_zh: 剖面分析確認鎢插塞裡有空洞。

items.def_en: The investigation that identifies how and why a part failed.
items.example: Failure analysis on the two returned units will take about ten working days.
items.example_zh: 兩顆退回品的失效分析大約需要十個工作天。

items.def_en: The ability to track a part back to its lot, tool and process history.
items.example: Traceability data lets us tie every failing unit to the same furnace batch.
items.example_zh: 履歷追溯資料讓我們把每顆失效品連回同一個爐批。

items.def_en: Another lot processed on the same tool at nearly the same time.
items.example: Two sister lots are on hold until the screening result comes back.
items.example_zh: 兩個同期批先扣住，等篩選結果回來再說。

items.def_en: The numbered week of the year, commonly written as WW32 in fab schedules.
items.example: The fix will be in production from work week 35 onward.
items.example_zh: 修正措施會從 WW35 開始導入量產。

items.def_en: A small production run used to evaluate a change before full release.
items.example: The trial run covered three lots and showed no yield impact.
items.example_zh: 試產做了三個批次，沒有看到良率影響。

items.def_en: Analysis that checks whether failing lots share the same equipment.
items.example: Tool commonality analysis pointed to furnace F02 in every failing lot.
items.example_zh: 機台共通性分析指出每個失效批都經過 F02 爐管。

items.def_en: A group of wafers processed with one condition changed on purpose.
items.example: The high-temperature split recovered the yield by 2.8 points.
items.example_zh: 高溫分組把良率拉回了 2.8 個百分點。

items.def_en: An asymmetric shift in a distribution away from its normal centre.
items.example: We saw a skew in the threshold voltage distribution toward the high side.
items.example_zh: 我們看到臨界電壓分佈往高的一側偏斜。

items.def_en: Reprocessing a wafer to correct a step that did not meet spec.
items.example: Six wafers went through rework and passed the follow-up inspection.
items.example_zh: 六片晶圓經過重工，並通過後續檢查。

items.def_en: To discard material that cannot be repaired or shipped.
items.example: We decided to scrap the two worst wafers instead of shipping them.
items.example_zh: 我們決定報廢最差的兩片晶圓，而不是出貨。

items.def_en: The ongoing improvement of yield as defects are found and removed.
items.example: Yield learning on this node is about one point per work week.
items.example_zh: 這個製程節點的良率學習大約是每週一個百分點。

items.def_en: A concrete item you promise to hand over by an agreed date.
items.example: The deliverable for this week is the interim 8D report, not the full analysis.
items.example_zh: 這週的交付項目是 8D 期中報告，不是完整分析。

items.def_en: A checkpoint in a schedule that marks meaningful progress.
items.example: The next milestone is the qualification review in WW38.
items.example_zh: 下一個里程碑是 WW38 的認證審查。

items.def_en: Anyone affected by a decision whose input or approval matters.
items.example: Please confirm with all stakeholders before we freeze the recipe.
items.example_zh: 在凍結配方前請先跟所有利害關係人確認。

items.def_en: To raise an issue to a higher level when it cannot be solved locally.
items.example: If the supplier misses the date again, we will escalate to their management.
items.example_zh: 如果供應商再度延期，我們會上呈到他們的管理層。

items.def_en: To make sure two sides agree on the same plan or understanding.
items.example: Let us align on the containment scope before we reply to the customer.
items.example_zh: 我們先對齊圍堵範圍，再回覆客戶。

items.def_en: A firm promise on scope, quality or date that others will plan around.
items.example: I can give you a commitment on the containment date, but not on the root cause yet.
items.example_zh: 我可以承諾圍堵完成日期，但根本原因還不行。

items.def_en: A limit on time, capacity or resources that shapes what is possible.
items.example: Our main constraint is tester capacity, not engineering effort.
items.example_zh: 我們主要的限制是測試機台產能，不是工程人力。

items.def_en: A backup plan or extra buffer kept in case things go wrong.
items.example: The schedule includes one week of contingency for retest.
items.example_zh: 時程裡留了一週的緩衝給重測。

items.def_en: A difference between two sets of data or statements that should match.
items.example: There is a discrepancy between our sort data and the customer incoming data.
items.example_zh: 我們的針測資料和客戶的來料檢驗資料之間有落差。

items.def_en: Whether a plan can realistically be done with the time and resources available.
items.example: We will check the feasibility of a two-week schedule and reply by Friday.
items.example_zh: 我們會評估兩週時程的可行性，週五前回覆。

items.def_en: A consequence that follows from a fact or decision, often not stated directly.
items.example: The main implication is that shipment will slip by one work week.
items.example_zh: 主要的影響是出貨會延後一個工作週。

items.def_en: To reduce how serious or how likely a risk is.
items.example: To mitigate the risk, we added a 100% screening test at final test.
items.example_zh: 為了降低風險，我們在終測加了 100% 全檢。

items.def_en: To decide which items get attention and resources first.
items.example: We prioritized the customer return over the internal experiment.
items.example_zh: 我們把客訴退回品排在內部實驗前面。

items.def_en: The reasoning behind a decision, explained so others can judge it.
items.example: Slide 4 gives the rationale for keeping the original spec limit.
items.example_zh: 第 4 頁說明維持原規格上限的理由。

items.def_en: To simplify a process so it takes fewer steps or less time.
items.example: We streamlined the review so the 8D can be released in five days.
items.example_zh: 我們簡化了審查流程，讓 8D 五天內就能發出。

items.def_en: A temporary way to keep going while the real fix is being developed.
items.example: The screening test is only a workaround until the new recipe is released.
items.example_zh: 篩選測試只是暫行對策，等新配方發布就會撤掉。

items.def_en: The spare time and attention a person or team has for extra work.
items.example: My team does not have the bandwidth to run both experiments this week.
items.example_zh: 我的團隊這週沒有餘力同時跑兩個實驗。

items.def_en: The time needed between placing a request and receiving the result.
items.example: The lead time for cross-section analysis is about seven working days.
items.example_zh: 剖面分析的前置時間大約七個工作天。

items.def_en: How long it takes to complete a task from start to finish.
items.example: We cut the turnaround time for FA reports from three weeks to ten days.
items.example_zh: 我們把 FA 報告的處理週期從三週縮到十天。

items.def_en: The gradual growth of a task beyond what was originally agreed.
items.example: Adding two more stress conditions is scope creep; let us handle it separately.
items.example_zh: 再加兩個應力條件就是範圍膨脹了，我們另案處理。

items.def_en: Responsible for the outcome and expected to answer for it.
items.example: The device team is accountable for closing the 8D by WW36.
items.example_zh: 元件團隊要負責在 WW36 前結案 8D。

items.def_en: Open to more than one interpretation, so it is unclear what is meant.
items.example: The spec wording is ambiguous, so both sides read the limit differently.
items.example_zh: 規格用字含糊，導致雙方對上限的解讀不同。

items.def_en: Short and clear, with nothing unnecessary.
items.example: Please keep the summary concise: three bullets on the front page.
items.example_zh: 摘要請寫得精簡：首頁三個重點就好。

items.def_en: Early and not yet confirmed, likely to change with more data.
items.example: These are preliminary results; the final data will come after retest.
items.example_zh: 這些是初步結果，最終資料要等重測後才有。

items.def_en: Arranged for now but still subject to change.
items.example: The tentative date for the con-call is Thursday at nine, Taiwan time.
items.example_zh: 電話會議暫定台灣時間週四九點。

items.def_en: Coming after something else in time or order.
items.example: No failures were found in subsequent lots after the recipe change.
items.example_zh: 配方變更後的後續批次都沒有發現失效。

items.def_en: Large enough to matter in practice, not marginal.
items.example: We saw a substantial improvement of 2.3 points after the fix.
items.example_zh: 修正後我們看到 2.3 個百分點的顯著改善。

items.def_en: Repeated or no longer needed because it adds nothing new.
items.example: The second screening step became redundant once the tool was fixed.
items.example_zh: 機台修好後，第二道篩選就變成多餘的了。

items.def_en: Meeting the rules, standards or specifications that apply.
items.example: The audit checked compliance with the customer quality manual.
items.example_zh: 稽核檢查的是對客戶品質手冊的合規性。

items.def_en: The person on the other side who holds the same role as you.
items.example: I will ask my counterpart at the customer to confirm the sample quantity.
items.example_zh: 我會請客戶端的對口確認樣品數量。

items.def_en: A task agreed in a meeting, with an owner and a due date.
items.example: There are three action items from the call, all owned by our side.
items.example_zh: 這通電話有三個待辦事項，全部由我方負責。

items.def_en: The written record of what was discussed and decided in a meeting.
items.example: I will send the minutes with the action items by end of day.
items.example_zh: 我會在今天下班前把會議紀錄和待辦事項寄出。

items.def_en: General agreement that everyone in the group can accept.
items.example: The consensus was to ship only the lots that passed the extra screening.
items.example_zh: 共識是只出貨通過額外篩選的批次。

items.def_en: The share of capacity, material or budget assigned to someone.
items.example: Our tester allocation for next month drops by twenty percent.
items.example_zh: 我們下個月的測試機台配額會減少百分之二十。

items.def_en: The evidence and reasoning given to support a request or decision.
items.example: The waiver request needs data as justification, not just an explanation.
items.example_zh: 特採申請需要資料作為佐證，不能只有說明。

items.def_en: Something taken as true without proof, which the conclusion depends on.
items.example: This estimate rests on the assumption that no new failures appear.
items.example_zh: 這個估算的前提是不會再出現新的失效。

items.def_en: A measured difference from the standard or expected value.
items.example: A small deviation from the target thickness was found on two wafers.
items.example_zh: 兩片晶圓被發現厚度與目標值有小幅偏差。

items.def_en: Written permission to accept material that is outside the normal spec.
items.example: The customer granted a one-time waiver for the affected lots.
items.example_zh: 客戶對受影響批次核准了一次性特採。

items.def_en: A short summary of what has been said or agreed so far.
items.example: Before questions, here is a quick recap of the three findings.
items.example_zh: 在提問之前，先快速回顧三項發現。

items.def_en: Further action taken to check progress or provide the rest of the answer.
items.example: As a follow-up, I will send the wafer maps for the two failing lots.
items.example_zh: 作為後續追蹤，我會把兩個失效批的晶圓圖寄過去。

items.def_en: Resistance or disagreement expressed against a proposal.
items.example: We got strong pushback on the two-week schedule during the review.
items.example_zh: 審查時兩週時程遭到強烈的反對意見。

items.def_en: To make brief contact to exchange updates.
items.example: Let us touch base on Friday once the retest data is available.
items.example_zh: 等重測資料出來，我們週五再簡短聯繫一下。

items.def_en: To return to a topic later, after other work is done.
items.example: Let us circle back to the cost impact after the FA result comes in.
items.example_zh: 等 FA 結果出來，我們再回來討論成本影響。

items.def_en: To include someone in a discussion or email thread.
items.example: I will loop in our reliability engineer for the retention question.
items.example_zh: 保存力的問題我會把可靠度工程師拉進來。

items.def_en: To check the progress of something raised earlier.
items.example: I am writing to follow up on the sample request from last week.
items.example_zh: 來信是想追蹤上週樣品申請的進度。

items.def_en: To reply to someone later with an answer.
items.example: Let me check with the fab and get back to you by Wednesday.
items.example_zh: 我跟晶圓廠確認後，週三前回覆您。

items.def_en: To show something to someone for their opinion or approval.
items.example: Let me run the draft reply by my manager before we send it.
items.example_zh: 回信草稿我先給主管過目再寄出。

items.def_en: To explain something step by step so the listener can follow.
items.example: Can you walk us through the failure signature on slide 3?
items.example_zh: 可以請你逐項講解第 3 頁的失效特徵嗎？

items.def_en: To look at a smaller part of the data in more detail.
items.example: If we drill down by tool, the failures come from one furnace only.
items.example_zh: 如果按機台深入細看，失效全來自同一台爐管。

items.def_en: To reduce a list of possibilities to the most likely ones.
items.example: We narrowed down the suspects to two process steps.
items.example_zh: 我們把嫌疑範圍縮小到兩道製程。

items.def_en: To eliminate a possible cause based on evidence.
items.example: The bake data lets us rule out a retention issue.
items.example_zh: 烘烤資料讓我們可以排除保存力的問題。

items.def_en: To investigate something to find out what is happening.
items.example: We are looking into the discrepancy between the two test sites.
items.example_zh: 我們正在調查兩個測試站之間的資料落差。

items.def_en: To keep someone informed as a situation develops.
items.example: I will keep you posted as soon as the screening result is out.
items.example_zh: 篩選結果一出來我就會隨時告知您。

items.def_en: To give someone the background information they missed.
items.example: Let me fill you in on what we found during the weekend.
items.example_zh: 我跟你補充說明一下我們週末查到的東西。

items.def_en: To give formal approval to a document or decision.
items.example: The customer has to sign off on the waiver before we can ship.
items.example_zh: 客戶必須簽核特採，我們才能出貨。

items.def_en: To delay doing something until a condition is met.
items.example: Please hold off on the shipment until the 8D interim report is approved.
items.example_zh: 請暫緩出貨，等 8D 期中報告核准再說。

items.def_en: To move a scheduled date to a later time.
items.example: We had to push out the qualification review by one work week.
items.example_zh: 我們必須把認證審查往後延一個工作週。

items.def_en: To raise a topic for discussion.
items.example: Thanks for bringing up the retention risk; we will add it to the plan.
items.example_zh: 謝謝你提出保存力的風險，我們會納入計畫。

items.def_en: To produce an idea, plan or solution.
items.example: The team came up with a screening method that takes only two hours.
items.example_zh: 團隊想出一個只要兩小時的篩選方法。

items.def_en: To make up a share of a total, or to explain why something happened.
items.example: Edge die account for eighty percent of the total fail count.
items.example_zh: 邊緣晶粒占總失效數的百分之八十。

items.def_en: To perform a planned task or test.
items.example: We carried out the split experiment on three lots last week.
items.example_zh: 我們上週在三個批次上執行了分組實驗。

items.def_en: To introduce a change into full production.
items.example: We will roll out the new recipe to all furnaces from WW35.
items.example_zh: 我們會從 WW35 起把新配方推行到所有爐管。

items.def_en: To focus attention on the most likely cause or area.
items.example: The commonality data let us zero in on furnace F02.
items.example_zh: 共通性資料讓我們鎖定 F02 爐管。

items.def_en: Matching or consistent with a standard or expectation.
items.example: The retest result is in line with our original baseline data.
items.example_zh: 重測結果與我們原本的基準資料一致。

items.def_en: Progressing as planned and likely to meet the target date.
items.example: The 8D is on track for release in WW36 as committed.
items.example_zh: 8D 進度正常，會照承諾在 WW36 發出。

items.def_en: Fully informed and able to work at the required level.
items.example: I will send the summary to bring the new engineer up to speed.
items.example_zh: 我會把摘要寄出，讓新工程師掌握最新狀況。

items.def_en: The gate voltage at which a memory cell starts to conduct, used to read its state.
items.example: The threshold voltage distribution shifted upward after one million read cycles.
items.example_zh: 一百萬次讀取後，臨界電壓分佈往上位移。

items.def_en: The horizontal control line that selects a row of cells in a memory array.
items.example: The failures are limited to two word lines in the same block.
items.example_zh: 失效僅限於同一個 block 內的兩條字元線。

items.def_en: The vertical line that carries data to and from a column of memory cells.
items.example: A bit line short would show a column pattern, which we do not see here.
items.example_zh: 位元線短路會呈現整行的分佈，但我們沒有看到這種形態。

items.def_en: The smallest unit that can be erased in a NAND flash device.
items.example: Each block contains hundreds of pages and is erased as a whole.
items.example_zh: 每個區塊包含數百個 page，抹除時整塊一起抹。

items.def_en: The smallest unit that can be programmed or read in one operation.
items.example: The disturb appeared on the page next to the one being programmed.
items.example_zh: 干擾出現在正在寫入的那一頁隔壁。

items.def_en: One complete program and erase operation on a block.
items.example: The device is rated for three thousand erase cycles at room temperature.
items.example_zh: 此元件在室溫下的規格是三千次抹除週期。

items.def_en: How long it takes to write data into a page.
items.example: Average program time increased by 8 percent after the recipe change.
items.example_zh: 配方變更後，平均寫入時間增加了 8%。

items.def_en: Redundant data that lets the controller repair a limited number of bad bits.
items.example: The raw error rate stayed within the error correction code budget.
items.example_zh: 原始錯誤率維持在錯誤更正碼的容許量之內。

items.def_en: Reserve blocks kept to replace blocks that fail during use.
items.example: Spare block usage is the first indicator we check on a field return.
items.example_zh: 備用區塊的使用量是我們檢查現場退回品時第一個看的指標。

items.def_en: A block marked unusable either at the factory or during operation.
items.example: The bad block count at test was within the specification limit.
items.example_zh: 測試時的壞塊數在規格範圍內。

items.def_en: A controller strategy that spreads writes evenly so no block wears out early.
items.example: Wear leveling explains why the failures are not concentrated in one block.
items.example_zh: 抹寫平均化解釋了為什麼失效沒有集中在單一區塊。

items.def_en: Background reorganisation of data to free up blocks for new writes.
items.example: Garbage collection was running during the test, which raised the read count.
items.example_zh: 測試期間垃圾回收正在執行，因此拉高了讀取次數。

items.def_en: The layer that stores charge in modern 3D NAND cells.
items.example: Charge trap devices behave differently from floating gate under stress.
items.example_zh: 電荷捕捉型元件在應力下的行為與浮閘式不同。

items.def_en: The thin oxide that electrons pass through during program and erase.
items.example: A thinner tunnel oxide at the edge explains the faster charge loss.
items.example_zh: 邊緣較薄的穿隧氧化層解釋了較快的電荷流失。

items.def_en: The isolated gate that stores charge in traditional flash cells.
items.example: The floating gate design was replaced by charge trap at this node.
items.example_zh: 這個節點已用電荷捕捉層取代浮閘設計。

items.def_en: The vertical layers that make up a 3D NAND array.
items.example: The failures cluster near the bottom of the stack.
items.example_zh: 失效集中在堆疊層的底部附近。

items.def_en: The process step that transfers a circuit pattern onto the wafer.
items.example: Lithography overlay error would show a repeating pattern, not an edge ring.
items.example_zh: 微影的疊對誤差會呈現重複性圖形，而不是邊緣環。

items.def_en: The process step that removes material to form structures.
items.example: The etch depth was 3 percent shallower than target on those wafers.
items.example_zh: 那些晶圓的蝕刻深度比目標值淺了 3%。

items.def_en: The process step that adds a thin film onto the wafer surface.
items.example: Deposition uniformity across the wafer is checked after every maintenance.
items.example_zh: 每次保養後都會檢查晶圓上的沉積均勻性。

items.def_en: A heat treatment step that repairs or activates the material.
items.example: We suspect the anneal step because the pattern follows the temperature profile.
items.example_zh: 我們懷疑退火製程，因為分佈與溫度輪廓一致。

items.def_en: A step that flattens the wafer surface between layers.
items.example: Chemical mechanical polishing dish-out can thin the film at the wafer edge.
items.example_zh: 化學機械研磨的凹陷會讓晶圓邊緣的薄膜變薄。

items.def_en: How accurately one patterned layer lines up with the layer beneath it.
items.example: Overlay data for those lots is within half of the control limit.
items.example_zh: 那些批次的疊對資料在管制界限的一半以內。

items.def_en: The measured width of the smallest features on the wafer.
items.example: Critical dimension at the wafer edge was 2 nanometres below target.
items.example_zh: 晶圓邊緣的關鍵尺寸比目標值小 2 奈米。

items.def_en: The light-sensitive coating used to transfer patterns during lithography.
items.example: A photoresist thickness variation would affect the whole wafer, not one ring.
items.example_zh: 光阻厚度變異會影響整片晶圓，而不是單一環狀區域。

items.def_en: A small contaminant on the wafer that can kill the die under it.
items.example: Particle counts on that tool doubled the week before the excursion.
items.example_zh: 異常發生前一週，該機台的顆粒數變成兩倍。

items.def_en: Unwanted material on the wafer or in the chamber that degrades the process.
items.example: Metal contamination was ruled out by the surface analysis result.
items.example_zh: 表面分析結果排除了金屬污染的可能。

items.def_en: The controlled environment where wafers are processed.
items.example: The cleanroom humidity alarm on 12 August is part of the timeline.
items.example_zh: 8 月 12 日的無塵室濕度警報也列入時間軸。

items.def_en: Automatic defect checking performed between process steps.
items.example: In-line inspection caught the defect two steps after the furnace.
items.example_zh: 線上檢查在爐管後兩站抓到了這個缺陷。

items.def_en: The measurement of film thickness, dimensions and other process outputs.
items.example: Metrology data shows the drift started three weeks before the yield loss.
items.example_zh: 量測資料顯示漂移比良率損失早了三週開始。

items.def_en: Using control charts to detect when a process moves off target.
items.example: Statistical process control did not flag the drift because the limits were too wide.
items.example_zh: 統計製程管制沒有標記出這個漂移，因為界限設得太寬。

items.def_en: A time plot with limits that shows whether a process stays stable.
items.example: The control chart shows seven points in a row above the centre line.
items.example_zh: 管制圖顯示連續七點落在中心線之上。

items.def_en: Showing a non-random pattern on a control chart, even if still within spec.
items.example: The process was out of control statistically two weeks before any lot failed.
items.example_zh: 在任何批次失效的兩週前，製程在統計上就已經失控了。

items.def_en: How much margin a process has between its spread and the specification limits.
items.example: Process capability dropped from 1.8 to 1.1 after the tool change.
items.example_zh: 換機台後製程能力從 1.8 掉到 1.1。

items.def_en: The rule that decides how many units to test out of a population.
items.example: The sampling plan requires 77 units per condition for reliability stress.
items.example_zh: 抽樣計畫要求可靠度應力每個條件 77 顆。

items.def_en: A known-good reference part used to check that a tester is behaving correctly.
items.example: We run the golden unit every shift to confirm tester health.
items.example_zh: 我們每個班別都跑一次標準件，確認測試機台狀態正常。

items.def_en: A lot tested on two systems to prove they give the same result.
items.example: The correlation lot showed 99.7 percent agreement between the two testers.
items.example_zh: 相關性驗證批顯示兩台測試機的判定一致率為 99.7%。

items.def_en: A lot run for evaluation rather than for shipment.
items.example: Two engineering lots were used to test the new recipe before production.
items.example_zh: 量產前用了兩個工程批來測試新配方。

items.def_en: A small line used to prove a process before full production.
items.example: The pilot line result matched the volume fab within one point.
items.example_zh: 試產線的結果與量產廠差距在一個百分點以內。

items.def_en: The period when production volume increases toward its target.
items.example: Yield learning during ramp up is about one point per work week.
items.example_zh: 產能爬升期間的良率學習大約每週一個百分點。

items.def_en: The point when a finished design is released to manufacturing.
items.example: The design change must land before tape out in WW38.
items.example_zh: 這項設計變更必須趕在 WW38 下線前完成。

items.def_en: The patterned plate used to project a layer image onto the wafer.
items.example: A mask defect would repeat at the same position on every die.
items.example_zh: 光罩缺陷會在每顆晶粒的相同位置重複出現。

items.def_en: The total number of die that physically fit on a wafer.
items.example: Gross die per wafer is 1,240 for this product.
items.example_zh: 這個產品每片晶圓的全數晶粒是 1,240 顆。

items.def_en: The back-end stage where die are packaged into finished parts.
items.example: The failure was reproduced before assembly, so packaging is ruled out.
items.example_zh: 失效在封裝前就重現了，因此排除封裝問題。

items.def_en: The housing that protects the die and connects it to the board.
items.example: No cracks were found in the package during the X-ray inspection.
items.example_zh: X 光檢查沒有在封裝體上發現裂縫。

items.def_en: The fine wire that connects the die pad to the package lead.
items.example: A lifted wire bond would fail continuity, which these units passed.
items.example_zh: 打線脫落會導致導通測試失敗，但這些樣品都通過了。

items.def_en: The ball of solder that joins a package to the customer's board.
items.example: Solder ball voids were within the acceptance criteria in all samples.
items.example_zh: 所有樣品的錫球空洞都在允收標準內。

items.def_en: A rating for how long a package can sit in open air before reflow.
items.example: The parts are moisture sensitivity level three, so bake before reflow if the bag was open.
items.example_zh: 這批是濕氣敏感等級三，若包裝已拆封，回流焊前要先烘烤。

items.def_en: A sudden static current that can damage a device during handling.
items.example: Electrostatic discharge damage usually leaves a visible mark at the pad.
items.example_zh: 靜電放電造成的損傷通常會在焊墊留下可見痕跡。

items.def_en: A destructive short circuit triggered by an over-voltage condition.
items.example: We tested for latch-up at 1.5 times the supply voltage with no failures.
items.example_zh: 我們在 1.5 倍供應電壓下測試閂鎖效應，沒有失效。

items.def_en: Unwanted current that flows when the device should be off.
items.example: Leakage current at high temperature is the parameter closest to the limit.
items.example_zh: 高溫下的漏電流是最接近規格上限的參數。

items.def_en: The current the device draws when it is powered but idle.
items.example: The standby current limit will be revised from 100 to 120 microamperes.
items.example_zh: 待機電流上限將從 100 微安培修訂為 120 微安培。

items.def_en: The worst-case combination of voltage, temperature and process used for testing.
items.example: The device passed at every corner condition including cold start.
items.example_zh: 元件在所有極端條件下都通過，包含低溫啟動。

items.def_en: Extra margin kept between the test limit and the datasheet limit.
items.example: We test with a 10 percent guard band so measurement error cannot cause an escape.
items.example_zh: 我們保留 10% 的保護帶，避免量測誤差造成漏檢。

items.def_en: The distance between the measured performance and the specification limit.
items.example: There is very little margin left on this parameter at high temperature.
items.example_zh: 這個參數在高溫下幾乎沒有餘裕了。

items.def_en: The share of possible failure modes that the test program can detect.
items.example: Test coverage for this failure mode was only 60 percent before the update.
items.example_zh: 更新前，這個失效模式的測試覆蓋率只有 60%。

items.def_en: A defective unit that passes test and reaches the customer.
items.example: One escape per million units is the target for this product family.
items.example_zh: 這個產品家族的目標是每百萬顆一個漏檢品。

items.def_en: A data point far away from the rest of the population.
items.example: We remove outliers only when we can explain them, not to make the chart look better.
items.example_zh: 只有在能解釋成因時才移除離群值，不能為了讓圖好看而移除。

items.def_en: How close repeated measurements of the same unit are to each other.
items.example: Repeatability of the new probe card is within 1 percent.
items.example_zh: 新探針卡的重複性在 1% 以內。

items.def_en: A study that separates measurement error from real product variation.
items.example: The gauge study showed the tool contributes 12 percent of the total variation.
items.example_zh: 量測系統分析顯示機台貢獻了總變異的 12%。

items.def_en: Adjusting an instrument against a known standard so its readings stay valid.
items.example: Three tools had calibration certificates that expired during the audit period.
items.example_zh: 有三台設備的校正證書在稽核期間已過期。

items.def_en: Scheduled servicing done before a tool fails.
items.example: Preventive maintenance on the furnace is now every six months instead of twelve.
items.example_zh: 爐管的預防保養已從十二個月改為每六個月一次。

items.def_en: Time when a tool is not available for production.
items.example: The extra shutdown adds about 1 percent downtime per month.
items.example_zh: 額外的停機每月增加約 1% 的停機時間。

items.def_en: How many units a tool or line can process per unit of time.
items.example: Throughput dropped slightly, but the yield gain more than covers it.
items.example_zh: 產出量略降，但良率的提升足以彌補。

items.def_en: The total time a lot takes to move through the line.
items.example: Adding the screening step increases cycle time by two days.
items.example_zh: 加入篩選站會讓生產週期增加兩天。

items.def_en: A unit sent back after failing in real use at the customer.
items.example: Field returns are analysed within ten working days of receipt.
items.example_zh: 現場退回品在收到後十個工作天內完成分析。

items.def_en: Extra testing added to remove suspect units before shipment.
items.example: The screening step is temporary and will be removed after verification.
items.example_zh: 這道篩選是暫時的，驗證通過後就會移除。

items.def_en: The list of topics to be covered in a meeting, in order.
items.example: I sent the agenda yesterday so everyone can prepare their numbers.
items.example_zh: 我昨天已寄出議程，讓大家先準備好各自的數字。

items.def_en: A person who takes part in a meeting.
items.example: Please add the reliability engineer as an attendee for the second half.
items.example_zh: 後半場請把可靠度工程師加為與會者。

items.def_en: To run a discussion so that the group reaches a decision.
items.example: Priya will facilitate the review so I can focus on the technical part.
items.example_zh: 會議由 Priya 主持，我才能專心處理技術部分。

items.def_en: To make something clearer by giving more detail or correcting a misunderstanding.
items.example: Let me clarify one point: the records are incomplete, but the material history is known.
items.example_zh: 我澄清一點：紀錄不完整，但材料的履歷是清楚的。

items.def_en: To give more detail about something already mentioned.
items.example: Could you elaborate on how the split experiment was designed?
items.example_zh: 可以請你詳細說明分組實驗是怎麼設計的嗎？

items.def_en: To give special importance to a point so the audience remembers it.
items.example: I want to emphasize that the containment covers all shipped material.
items.example_zh: 我要強調圍堵措施涵蓋了所有已出貨的材料。

items.def_en: To draw attention to the most important part of something.
items.example: The red box on slide 5 highlights the three failing lots.
items.example_zh: 第 5 頁的紅框凸顯了三個失效批次。

items.def_en: To describe the main points without going into detail.
items.example: Let me outline the plan first, then we can go into each step.
items.example_zh: 我先概述整個計畫，接著再逐步細談。

items.def_en: To state the key points briefly at the end.
items.example: To summarize, the mechanism is confirmed and yield is back to baseline.
items.example_zh: 總結來說，機制已確認，良率也回到基準水準。

items.def_en: To express something as a number instead of a description.
items.example: Can you quantify the impact on shipment in units, not in words?
items.example_zh: 可以請你用數量而不是形容詞來量化對出貨的影響嗎？

items.def_en: An approximate figure based on the information available.
items.example: This estimate assumes no further failures in the verification lots.
items.example_zh: 這個估算的前提是驗證批不會再出現失效。

items.def_en: A projection of future demand, capacity or results.
items.example: The forecast for next quarter assumes the new recipe is released in WW36.
items.example_zh: 下一季的預估是以新配方在 WW36 放行為前提。

items.def_en: The boundary of what a task, report or investigation covers.
items.example: That question is outside the scope of today's review.
items.example_zh: 那個問題超出今天檢討的範圍。

items.def_en: The specific result a piece of work is meant to achieve.
items.example: The objective of the trial run is to confirm the yield gain is repeatable.
items.example_zh: 試產的目標是確認良率提升可以重現。

items.def_en: The standard used to decide whether something passes or fails.
items.example: The release criterion is three consecutive lots above 93 percent.
items.example_zh: 放行標準是連續三批高於 93%。

items.def_en: A reference point used to judge whether performance is good.
items.example: Our cycle time is two days longer than the industry benchmark.
items.example_zh: 我們的生產週期比業界基準長兩天。

items.def_en: A number that is tracked over time to judge performance.
items.example: Escape rate is the metric the customer cares about most.
items.example_zh: 漏檢率是客戶最在意的指標。

items.def_en: A signal that suggests something is changing, often before the result shows.
items.example: Spare block usage is an early indicator of a reliability problem.
items.example_zh: 備用區塊使用量是可靠度問題的早期徵兆。

items.def_en: The general direction in which a number is moving over time.
items.example: The trend has been flat for three weeks, which is what we expect.
items.example_zh: 趨勢已連續三週持平，符合我們的預期。

items.def_en: The spread of a set of values, or the gap between plan and actual.
items.example: The variance between the two testers is larger than the product variation.
items.example_zh: 兩台測試機之間的差距比產品本身的變異還大。

items.def_en: A proposed explanation that still has to be tested.
items.example: Our hypothesis is that the drift changed the film thickness at the edge.
items.example_zh: 我們的假說是漂移改變了邊緣的薄膜厚度。

items.def_en: To prove that something does what it is supposed to do.
items.example: We will validate the new limit on three production lots.
items.example_zh: 我們會用三個量產批驗證新的界限。

items.def_en: To check that something is true or meets the requirement.
items.example: Please verify the serial numbers before the units are shipped back.
items.example_zh: 退回品寄出前請先查核序號。

items.def_en: To formally agree that something can proceed.
items.example: The customer has to approve the waiver before we can ship.
items.example_zh: 客戶必須核准特採，我們才能出貨。

items.def_en: To publicly support a proposal or decision.
items.example: The quality director will endorse the plan if the data supports it.
items.example_zh: 只要資料站得住，品質總監會為這個計畫背書。

items.def_en: To give someone official permission to act.
items.example: Only the plant manager can authorize a shipment under waiver.
items.example_zh: 只有廠長能授權以特採方式出貨。

items.def_en: To give a task and the authority for it to someone else.
items.example: I will delegate the tool log review to the process team.
items.example_zh: 機台日誌的檢視我會交辦給製程團隊。

items.def_en: To organise several people or activities so they work together.
items.example: I will coordinate with the fab so the split runs on the same day.
items.example_zh: 我會與晶圓廠協調，讓分組實驗在同一天投料。

items.def_en: To combine several items into one clearer whole.
items.example: Please consolidate the three reports into one summary for the customer.
items.example_zh: 請把三份報告彙整成一份給客戶的摘要。

items.def_en: To assign a share of capacity, budget or people to a task.
items.example: We can allocate two testers to the correlation study next week.
items.example_zh: 下週我們可以分配兩台測試機給相關性驗證。

items.def_en: To postpone a decision or task to a later time.
items.example: Let us defer the cost discussion to the next call.
items.example_zh: 成本的討論我們延到下次會議。

items.def_en: To make something happen faster than the normal process.
items.example: We asked the lab to expedite the cross-section for the customer case.
items.example_zh: 我們請實驗室對這個客訴案的剖面分析加急處理。

items.def_en: To complete the last details so nothing more will change.
items.example: We will finalize the report after the last two units are analysed.
items.example_zh: 最後兩顆分析完成後，我們就會把報告定案。

items.def_en: To start a formal process or action.
items.example: We will initiate the change request this week.
items.example_zh: 我們本週會啟動變更申請。

items.def_en: To put a plan or change into actual practice.
items.example: The fix was implemented in WW32 on all furnaces of the same type.
items.example_zh: 修正措施已於 WW32 在所有同型爐管上導入。

items.def_en: To change a document or figure to a corrected version.
items.example: We will revise the datasheet limit from 100 to 120 microamperes.
items.example_zh: 我們會把規格書的上限從 100 修訂為 120 微安培。

items.def_en: To replace an older document or version, which then stops being valid.
items.example: This notice supersedes the version issued last month.
items.example_zh: 本通知取代上個月發出的版本。

items.def_en: To act in line with a rule, standard or requirement.
items.example: All shipped material must comply with the customer quality manual.
items.example_zh: 所有出貨材料都必須符合客戶的品質手冊。

items.def_en: To make sure a rule is actually followed, usually by a system or authority.
items.example: The booking system now enforces the calibration rule automatically.
items.example_zh: 預約系統現在會自動強制執行校正規定。

items.def_en: To look at something carefully to find defects or confirm quality.
items.example: We will inspect the current stock over the weekend and confirm on Sunday.
items.example_zh: 我們會在週末檢查現有庫存，週日給確認。

items.def_en: To watch a value over time so a change is noticed early.
items.example: We will monitor the field return rate monthly for the next six months.
items.example_zh: 接下來六個月我們會每月監控現場退回率。

items.def_en: To follow the progress of an item until it is closed.
items.example: I will track the two open items and update you every Monday.
items.example_zh: 我會追蹤這兩個未結項目，每週一向您更新。

items.def_en: To point out a risk or issue early so others can react.
items.example: One risk I want to flag early is the tester capacity in WW38.
items.example_zh: 我想提早示警一個風險：WW38 的測試機台產能。

items.def_en: A formal message informing someone of a change or event.
items.example: The process change notification was sent to all affected customers.
items.example_zh: 製程變更通知已寄給所有受影響的客戶。

items.def_en: A reply confirming that a message or requirement has been received.
items.example: We need written acknowledgment of this notice by 30 August.
items.example_zh: 我們需要在 8 月 30 日前收到本通知的書面回執。

items.def_en: A statement that makes an arrangement or fact definite.
items.example: Please send written confirmation with the action items today.
items.example_zh: 請於今日寄出含待辦事項的書面確認。

items.def_en: Extra explanation given to remove a misunderstanding.
items.example: One clarification before we continue: the limit applies to this lot only.
items.example_zh: 繼續之前先澄清一點：這個界限只適用於本批次。

items.def_en: A case that is allowed to deviate from the normal rule.
items.example: Shipping under waiver is an exception and needs management approval.
items.example_zh: 以特採出貨屬於例外，需要管理層核准。

items.def_en: An earlier case that others may use to justify the same treatment.
items.example: We must limit the scope so this waiver does not become a precedent.
items.example_zh: 我們必須限定範圍，避免這次特採變成前例。

items.def_en: A specific clause in a contract or agreement.
items.example: The quality agreement has a provision for notification within 48 hours.
items.example_zh: 品質協議中有一條 48 小時內通知的條款。

items.def_en: Legal or financial responsibility for a loss.
items.example: The liability question should be handled by the commercial team, not by us.
items.example_zh: 賠償責任的問題應由業務團隊處理，不該由我們回答。

items.def_en: A financial or contractual consequence of failing to meet a commitment.
items.example: A late delivery penalty applies if we miss the committed date twice.
items.example_zh: 若連續兩次錯過承諾日期，就會觸發延遲交貨罰則。

items.def_en: The action taken to put right a loss or defect.
items.example: The agreed remedy is replacement at no charge within four weeks.
items.example_zh: 雙方同意的補救措施是四週內免費更換。

items.def_en: Payment made to cover a cost that the other side had to pay.
items.example: The customer requested reimbursement for the extra incoming inspection.
items.example_zh: 客戶要求補償額外來料檢驗的費用。

items.def_en: The document that lists what was shipped and what is owed.
items.example: The affected units were shipped under invoice INV-2208.
items.example_zh: 受影響的產品是依 INV-2208 出貨的。

items.def_en: The customer document that authorises a specific quantity and price.
items.example: The purchase order covers 20,000 units for delivery in WW40.
items.example_zh: 這張採購訂單涵蓋 WW40 交貨的兩萬顆。

items.def_en: The person responsible for completing a specific action item.
items.example: Every open item needs an owner and a due date.
items.example_zh: 每個未結項目都要有負責人和期限。

items.def_en: The number of people assigned to a team or task.
items.example: We cannot add headcount this quarter, so we have to prioritize.
items.example_zh: 這一季無法增加員額，所以必須排優先順序。

items.def_en: The amount of work assigned to a person or team.
items.example: The extra screening doubles the workload for the test floor.
items.example_zh: 額外的篩選讓測試現場的工作量變成兩倍。

items.def_en: The maximum output a line or tool can deliver in a period.
items.example: Test capacity, not engineering effort, is the limiting factor here.
items.example_zh: 這裡的限制因素是測試產能，不是工程人力。

items.def_en: The share of available time a tool is actually producing.
items.example: Tester utilization is already above 90 percent on the day shift.
items.example_zh: 白班的測試機稼動率已經超過 90%。

items.def_en: Work that has piled up and is waiting to be done.
items.example: The FA backlog is eleven cases, which is why the queue is long.
items.example_zh: 失效分析積壓了十一個案子，所以排隊時間才這麼長。

items.def_en: The step that limits the speed of the whole flow.
items.example: The bottleneck is the cross-section lab, not the electrical test.
items.example_zh: 瓶頸在剖面分析實驗室，不在電性測試。

items.def_en: Something that must happen before another task can start.
items.example: The verification run has a dependency on the furnace maintenance.
items.example_zh: 驗證投料與爐管保養之間有相依關係。

items.def_en: A condition that must be met before something else can proceed.
items.example: Customer approval is a prerequisite for shipping under waiver.
items.example_zh: 客戶核准是以特採出貨的前提條件。

items.def_en: A situation where gaining one thing means giving up another.
items.example: The trade-off is one percent throughput against a much lower escape risk.
items.example_zh: 這個取捨是用 1% 的產出量換取大幅降低的漏檢風險。

items.def_en: To make good use of something you already have.
items.example: We can leverage the existing correlation data instead of running a new study.
items.example_zh: 我們可以善用既有的相關性資料，不必重做一次研究。

items.def_en: Able to keep working correctly even when conditions vary.
items.example: The new recipe is more robust against small pressure changes.
items.example_zh: 新配方對壓力的小幅變化更為穩健。

items.def_en: Deliberately cautious, leaving extra margin for safety.
items.example: The date I gave is conservative; we should finish two days earlier.
items.example_zh: 我給的日期是保守的，實際上應該會提早兩天完成。

items.def_en: Ambitious to the point of leaving little or no margin.
items.example: That schedule is aggressive; any retest would break it.
items.example_zh: 那個時程偏緊，只要重測一次就會破功。

items.def_en: Achievable given the actual constraints.
items.example: If Wednesday is not realistic, give me a date that is.
items.example_zh: 如果週三並不可行，就給我一個做得到的日期。

items.def_en: Able to be kept up over the long term without extra effort.
items.example: Manual screening works this month but is not sustainable.
items.example_zh: 人工篩選這個月行得通，但無法長期維持。

items.def_en: Happening in small steps rather than all at once.
items.example: We prefer incremental changes so each one can be verified separately.
items.example_zh: 我們偏好漸進式的變更，這樣每一步都能單獨驗證。

items.def_en: Only just inside or outside the limit, with almost no margin.
items.example: Eight of the nine units were marginal rather than genuinely bad.
items.example_zh: 九顆裡有八顆是邊際品，而不是真的不良。

items.def_en: Covering everything that needs to be covered.
items.example: The customer asked for a comprehensive review of all furnace types.
items.example_zh: 客戶要求對所有爐管型號做全面檢視。

items.def_en: Done carefully and thoroughly, following the method exactly.
items.example: The auditor expects a rigorous impact assessment, not a summary.
items.example_zh: 稽核員要的是嚴謹的影響評估，不是摘要。

items.def_en: Open about what is known and what is not.
items.example: Being transparent about the open items builds more trust than a clean story.
items.example_zh: 誠實揭露未結項目比講一個完美的故事更能建立信任。

items.def_en: Acting before a problem appears rather than reacting to it.
items.example: Sending a weekly update is a proactive way to reduce escalation.
items.example_zh: 每週主動更新是減少客訴升級的好方法。

items.def_en: Required, with no option to skip it.
items.example: The bake step is mandatory once the moisture bag has been opened.
items.example_zh: 防潮袋一旦拆封，烘烤就是強制步驟。

items.def_en: Available but not required.
items.example: The second cross-section is optional if the first one is conclusive.
items.example_zh: 若第一次剖面就有結論，第二次剖面是選擇性的。

items.def_en: Waiting for a decision or result before it can move on.
items.example: Twelve wafers are on hold pending the failure analysis result.
items.example_zh: 十二片晶圓仍在扣留中，等待失效分析結果。

items.def_en: Still not finished or not yet delivered.
items.example: Only the verification run is outstanding; everything else is closed.
items.example_zh: 只剩驗證投料尚未完成，其餘都已結案。

items.def_en: No longer valid or no longer produced.
items.example: That specification is obsolete; please use revision C.
items.example_zh: 該規格已作廢，請改用 C 版。

items.def_en: Covering the period until the final version is ready.
items.example: The interim report states what is known and what is still open.
items.example_zh: 期中報告要說明已知什麼、還有什麼未結。

items.def_en: To separate something into smaller parts so it can be understood.
items.example: Let me break down the fail count by bin and by wafer position.
items.example_zh: 我把失效數按 bin 和晶圓位置拆開來看。

items.def_en: To draw attention to a fact, often one others have missed.
items.example: Thank you for pointing out the gap between the two dates.
items.example_zh: 謝謝您指出兩個日期之間的落差。

items.def_en: To work out the answer to something after some effort.
items.example: We still need to figure out why the drift started four weeks earlier.
items.example_zh: 我們還需要弄清楚為什麼漂移提早了四週開始。

items.def_en: To deal with a problem so it stops blocking progress.
items.example: We will sort out the socket issue before the next correlation run.
items.example_zh: 下次相關性驗證前，我們會先處理好插座的問題。

items.def_en: To calculate or plan something in detail.
items.example: Can you work out how many testers we need for the extra screening?
items.example_zh: 可以請你算一下額外篩選需要幾台測試機嗎？

items.def_en: To end up being the case, often differently from what was expected.
items.example: It turned out that only one furnace was involved, not three.
items.example_zh: 結果只牽涉到一台爐管，不是三台。

items.def_en: To reach a final state, usually unplanned.
items.example: If we skip the split, we will end up guessing the root cause.
items.example_zh: 如果跳過分組實驗，最後就只能用猜的找根本原因。

items.def_en: To arrange a meeting, or to build a test environment.
items.example: I will set up a call with the fab for Thursday morning.
items.example_zh: 我會安排週四早上與晶圓廠的電話會議。

items.def_en: To finish what was promised rather than stopping halfway.
items.example: We committed to a weekly update, so we have to follow through.
items.example_zh: 我們承諾了每週更新，就必須貫徹到底。

items.def_en: To do work that should already have been done.
items.example: I need to catch up on the FA backlog before taking new cases.
items.example_zh: 接新案子前，我得先把積壓的失效分析補上。

items.def_en: To contact someone briefly for an update.
items.example: Let me check in with the lab and confirm the queue position.
items.example_zh: 我跟實驗室確認一下排隊的順位。

items.def_en: To make contact with someone, often outside your usual group.
items.example: I will reach out to the tester vendor about the socket design.
items.example_zh: 插座設計的問題我會主動聯繫測試機供應商。

items.def_en: To keep to a plan, rule or schedule without changing it.
items.example: Let us stick to the agenda and take the cost topic offline.
items.example_zh: 我們照議程走，成本的議題會後再談。

items.def_en: To support a claim with evidence.
items.example: Every statement in the 8D should be backed up by data.
items.example_zh: 8D 裡的每一句話都應該有資料佐證。

items.def_en: To cancel something that was planned.
items.example: We had to call off the trial because the furnace went down.
items.example_zh: 因為爐管故障，我們必須取消試產。

items.def_en: To move something to a later time.
items.example: Do not put off the bad news; the customer will find out anyway.
items.example_zh: 壞消息不要拖，客戶遲早會知道。

items.def_en: To become responsible for something someone else was doing.
items.example: I will take over this case while Anna is on vacation.
items.example_zh: Anna 休假期間這個案子由我接手。

items.def_en: To pass responsibility and information to another person.
items.example: Please hand over the open items with the tool logs attached.
items.example_zh: 交接未結項目時請一併附上機台日誌。

items.def_en: To prepare a plan or document in written form.
items.example: We will draw up a recovery plan and send it today.
items.example_zh: 我們會擬定復原計畫，今天寄出。

items.def_en: To present information in a clear and ordered way.
items.example: Slide 2 lays out the timeline from detection to containment.
items.example_zh: 第 2 頁清楚陳述了從發現到圍堵的時間軸。

items.def_en: To plan the steps of something in detail.
items.example: Let us map out the verification plan before we book the tools.
items.example_zh: 預約機台前，我們先把驗證計畫規劃出來。

items.def_en: To establish an exact fact, date or cause.
items.example: We could not pin down the exact day the drift started.
items.example_zh: 我們無法確定漂移確切是哪一天開始的。

items.def_en: To find something after searching for it.
items.example: It took two days to track down the parent lots of the returned units.
items.example_zh: 花了兩天才查出退回品的母批。

items.def_en: To remove the unwanted items from a group.
items.example: The extra bake weeds out units with marginal retention.
items.example_zh: 額外的烘烤可以剔除保存力偏弱的產品。

items.def_en: To stop using something gradually rather than all at once.
items.example: The old recipe will be phased out over the next two quarters.
items.example_zh: 舊配方會在接下來兩季逐步淘汰。

items.def_en: To increase production or effort to a larger level.
items.example: We will scale up to full production once three lots pass.
items.example_zh: 三個批次通過後我們就會放大到全量產。

items.def_en: To reduce the size or scope of something.
items.example: We had to scale back the experiment because of tester capacity.
items.example_zh: 因為測試機台產能不足，我們必須縮減實驗規模。

items.def_en: To get involved in order to help or to take control.
items.example: Management had to step in when the date slipped twice.
items.example_zh: 日期兩度跳票後，管理層必須介入處理。

items.def_en: To attend a meeting as an observer rather than a participant.
items.example: Would you mind if our new engineer sits in on the call?
items.example_zh: 介意讓我們的新工程師列席這通會議嗎？

items.def_en: To keep supporting a statement, or to stay ready to act.
items.example: We stand by the conclusion in the report; the data has not changed.
items.example_zh: 我們維持報告中的結論，資料並沒有改變。

items.def_en: To remain valid under scrutiny, or to delay something.
items.example: The schedule will not hold up if the retest fails.
items.example_zh: 如果重測沒過，這個時程就撐不住。

items.def_en: To keep information or material back instead of releasing it.
items.example: Do not hold back the open items; the customer prefers an honest list.
items.example_zh: 未結項目不要保留不說，客戶寧可看到誠實的清單。

items.def_en: To move a date or event to an earlier time.
items.example: Can we bring forward the review to Tuesday?
items.example_zh: 可以把檢討會提前到週二嗎？

items.def_en: To propose an idea or plan for others to consider.
items.example: The team put forward two options and we chose the safer one.
items.example_zh: 團隊提出兩個方案，我們選了比較保險的那個。

items.def_en: To review something in detail with someone.
items.example: Let us go over the containment list before the call.
items.example_zh: 開會前我們先逐項檢視圍堵清單。

items.def_en: To examine step by step, or to pass through a process.
items.example: All failing lots went through the same furnace last month.
items.example_zh: 所有失效批次上個月都經過同一台爐管。

items.def_en: To proceed with something, often after approval.
items.example: The customer gave the go ahead to ship the screened material.
items.example_zh: 客戶同意放行已篩選的材料出貨。

items.def_en: To make an idea understood by the audience.
items.example: The main message I want to get across is that shipments are protected.
items.example_zh: 我最想傳達清楚的訊息是：出貨已受到保護。

items.def_en: To finally do something that has been waiting.
items.example: I have not got around to the second cross-section yet.
items.example_zh: 第二次剖面我還沒抽出時間做。

items.def_en: To find something by chance, or to give a certain impression.
items.example: We came across a similar signature in a case from last year.
items.example_zh: 我們在去年的一個案子裡遇到過類似的失效特徵。

items.def_en: To be reduced to one key factor in the end.
items.example: The decision comes down to whether we can accept a 4 percent escape.
items.example_zh: 這個決定歸結為我們能不能接受 4% 的漏檢。

items.def_en: To simplify to the essential point.
items.example: It boils down to one question: can we hold the WW36 date?
items.example_zh: 簡化來說就是一個問題：WW36 這個日期守不守得住？

items.def_en: To make sense when all the facts are put together.
items.example: The timeline does not add up, so we are checking the logs again.
items.example_zh: 時間軸兜不起來，所以我們正在重新檢查日誌。

items.def_en: A rough practical guideline rather than an exact rule.
items.example: As a rule of thumb, we keep a 10 percent guard band on every limit.
items.example_zh: 依經驗法則，每個界限我們都留 10% 的保護帶。

items.def_en: Applying to everything or everyone in a group.
items.example: The new limit applies across the board, not only to the tool that drifted.
items.example_zh: 新的界限全面適用，不只是發生漂移的那一台機台。

items.def_en: Kept informed about what is happening.
items.example: Please keep the quality team in the loop on every customer reply.
items.example_zh: 每一封回客戶的信都請讓品質團隊在訊息圈內。

items.term: off the top of my head
items.def_en: Said from memory without checking, so it may not be exact.
items.example: Off the top of my head it is about forty lots, but let me confirm.
items.example_zh: 憑印象大約是四十批，但我確認一下再回覆您。

items.def_en: Sharing the same understanding of a situation or plan.
items.example: Before we close, let us make sure we are on the same page about the date.
items.example_zh: 結束前，我們先確認雙方對日期的認知一致。

items.def_en: A fixed time at which you must leave a meeting.
items.example: I have a hard stop at half past ten, so let us start with the data.
items.example_zh: 我十點半有硬性結束時間，所以我們先從資料開始。

items.def_en: To move a topic out of the meeting and discuss it separately.
items.example: That is a detailed question; can we take it offline after the call?
items.example_zh: 這個問題比較細，我們會後再談好嗎？
